detailed_findings.finding: The moved-point and fixed-point label conditions are verified exactly as required by the lemma.

reason: The proof is correct and complete. It partitions X into the zero-labeled set Z and one-labeled set O, enumerates them as Z = {z_1,...,z_n} and O = {o_1,...,o_m} with n >= m by hypothesis, pairs each o_i with z_i, and fixes the remaining zeros. The resulting map is total, well-defined, involutive, flips labels on every moved point, and has only zero-labeled fixed points. This matches the lemma statement exactly and uses no undeclared or forbidden dependencies.
